decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to building shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.
Condition : 5 - No more than 26 children shall be present at the premises at any one time unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted shall not be carried on or outside the hours of 8.00am to 6.00pm Monday to Friday.
description: Change of use of snooker room of existing sports club to day nursery for children age (2-5) years between Monday to Friday.
